# Old Amsterdam Switzerland

> Old Amsterdam is a premium aged Gouda cheese from the Netherlands (Westland Kaas Groep BV). In Switzerland it is sold at Coop and MANOR FOOD. The official Swiss website helps you find the nearest store by postal code or town. Website: https://oldamsterdam.ch

Old Amsterdam is matured on wooden shelves for about 8 months, which gives it its characteristic crunchy crystals and a robust, slightly sweet flavour. It has been made since 1985 and is sold in more than 60 countries. In Switzerland, NECTRA FOOD SA is the importer and distributor.

## Swiss availability
- Coop: 341 stores across Switzerland (per the Swiss website)
- MANOR FOOD: 23 stores across Switzerland (per the Swiss website)
- Find the nearest store: https://oldamsterdam.ch/en/#where-to-buy (search by postal code, town, or device location)
- Online: Coop.ch search for Old Amsterdam: https://www.coop.ch/de/search/?text=old+amsterdam

## Products sold in Switzerland
- Old Amsterdam Classic Wedge, 210 g: aged Gouda with crystals, sharp yet creamy.
- Old Amsterdam Slices, 115 g (10 slices): pre-sliced aged Gouda for sandwiches and snacks.

## Awards
- World Cheese Awards 2025, Bern, Switzerland (over 4,000 cheeses blind-tasted):
  - Old Amsterdam Classic: Gold
  - Old Amsterdam Goat: Gold
  - Old Amsterdam Reserve: Bronze
- Source (official press release, November 2025): https://oldamsterdam.com/news/old-amsterdam-triumphs-at-world-cheese-awards-2025/

## FAQ (short answers)
- What is Old Amsterdam? A premium aged Gouda from the Netherlands, matured about 8 months.
- Where can I buy it in Switzerland? At Coop and MANOR FOOD stores; use the store finder on the website.
- Who distributes it in Switzerland? NECTRA FOOD SA, exclusive importer for Old Amsterdam and Westland cheeses.
- Is it Dutch Gouda or Swiss? It is Dutch Gouda, made in the Netherlands.

## Résumé en français
Old Amsterdam est un Gouda premium affiné, fabriqué aux Pays-Bas. En Suisse, il est vendu chez Coop (341 magasins) et MANOR FOOD (23 magasins). Le site https://oldamsterdam.ch/fr/ permet de trouver le magasin le plus proche par code postal ou localité.

## Zusammenfassung auf Deutsch
Old Amsterdam ist ein gereifter Premium-Gouda aus den Niederlanden. In der Schweiz ist er bei Coop (341 Filialen) und MANOR FOOD (23 Filialen) erhältlich. Auf https://oldamsterdam.ch/de/ finden Sie die nächste Filiale über Postleitzahl oder Ortschaft.

## Riassunto in italiano
